reference.name: Backpack Check
reference.text:
Problem: Backpack Check
START
INPUT number of textbooks
INPUT weight of one textbook
INPUT student weight
SET backpack weight TO number of textbooks * weight of one textbook
SET guideline TO student weight / 10
IF backpack weight <= guideline THEN
    PRINT "The backpack is a safe weight"
ELSE
    PRINT "The backpack is over the guideline"
END IF
END

reference.name: Screen Time
reference.text:
Problem: Screen Time
START
INPUT minutes on day 1
INPUT minutes on day 2
INPUT minutes on day 3
INPUT minutes on day 4
INPUT minutes on day 5
INPUT minutes on day 6
INPUT minutes on day 7
SET total minutes TO day 1 + day 2 + day 3 + day 4 + day 5 + day 6 + day 7
SET daily average TO total minutes / 7
IF daily average <= 120 THEN
    PRINT "Within the 120-minute daily limit"
ELSE
    PRINT "Averaging over the daily limit"
END IF
END

reference.name: Print Job
reference.text:
Problem: Print Job
START
INPUT number of pages
SET job cost TO number of pages * 0.08
IF job cost <= 5.00 THEN
    PRINT "The job can be printed"
ELSE
    PRINT "Not enough left in the account"
END IF
END

reference.name: different words and keywords (Backpack Check, lowercase, otherwise)
reference.text:
Problem: Backpack Check
start
get how many textbooks
get what one textbook weighs
get the student's weight
set pack weight to books times the weight of one
set the limit to the student's weight divided by 10
if the pack weight is at most the limit
    report that the pack is fine
otherwise
    report that the pack is too heavy
end

reference.name: different words and keywords (Print Job, reversed question, branches swapped to match; cents against 500)
reference.text:
Problem: Print Job
BEGIN
READ pages
COMPUTE cost in cents = pages * 8
IF cost in cents > 500 THEN
    OUTPUT the account does not have enough
ELSE
    OUTPUT the job can print
END IF
STOP

reference.name: terse Screen Time with the average inside one line
reference.text:
Problem: Screen Time
START
INPUT d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6, d7
SET avg TO (d1 + d2 + d3 + d4 + d5 + d6 + d7) / 7
IF avg > 120 THEN
    PRINT "over the limit"
ELSE
    PRINT "within the limit"
END IF
END
